At this point, this ramshackle bar is assembled.  The 'walls' are a circle of broken material, mostly from the previous pub that was here, but also anything found around town after the fires, flooding, attacks.  Dead kelp is being used to bind much if the structure togeather.  There is a large water proof tarp being used for a ceiling.  Inside the ring are multiple tables that are not in the best condition, but useable, and parts of the old bar and stage now makeup one side of the pub.  Where the old door was, it is just an opening in the ring, using the door as a bridge on the ground, from the Town Square to the inside of the pub itself.  Next to the opening is a painted sign with the following:
```If you are a dreamer, come in.
If you are a dreamer, a wisher, a liar,
A hope-er, a pray-er, a magic bean buyer . . .
If you’re a pretender, come sit by my fire,
For we have some flax golden tales to spin.
Come in!
Come in!```
